cohort: 83 women with adenomyosis treated with GnRH agonists and 83 women with normal uteri undergoing IVF
finding: GnRH agonist treatment in women with adenomyosis resulted in comparable live birth rates to the control group, suggesting it optimizes fertility outcomes.
mod_finding: The incidence of preterm deliveries and antepartum hemorrhage was found to be significantly increased in the adenomyosis group.
